svg.title: Harsha — Developer Field Console
svg.desc: Harsha's developer profile, experiments, systems interests, operating philosophy, and technical surface.

g.text: A person who builds things to understand them,
then breaks them to understand them better.
Not projects for the sake of having projects. Small systems built to answer larger questions.
npm / shipped / first system that felt real
Graphics and vector work that outgrew a curiosity.
because one machine was not enough.
AIML UNDERGRAD // COURSEWORK GATHERS DUST; EXPERIMENTS DO NOT.
